name: Takasugi Haruka
source:
A junior voice actress.
Hobby: Saving money, Seasonal food
A new junior voice actress belonging to "Gakepuchi Production".
Although she was raised in a family that could not be called wealthy, she lives her life with a positive attitude and cheerfulness. Because of this, she looks young but is a very good girl. She loves cheap bean sprouts, and is sometimes called a bean sprout idol, rather than a healing type. Her daily routine is to check if there are any coins under vending machines. She also participates in ComicFy in cosplay. During one of her cosplays, she showed off her cosplay of "Yachi Nagakura" from "Gakuen☆Shinsengumi".
She is also a talented gag manga artist, and not only does she make Kenji, but also Hisui and Chika laugh out loud, so much so that even the deputy editor-in-chief, who is strict at work, becomes soft on her. If she is made the heroine, she will use this talent to write the scenario for Kenji's new work.
